introHtml: Blue counter mats add a professional touch to any checkout or service counter while protecting surfaces from spills and scratches. Whether you need branded mats for a retail store, restaurant, or office reception area, the blue color offers a clean, calming look that complements many brand palettes. Choose from standard or custom sizes and add your logo with full-color printing or screen printing for a durable finish that lasts.
